analysis.population: six frozen small/medium C/C++ projects only
analysis.power_claim: fixed-sample mechanism study; not powered confirmation

primary.estimand: mean of six project scores over twelve matched checkpoints

secondary.gate: primary statistical and practical criteria both pass

supportive.report: effect size and stratum descriptions only

checkpoint_contract.capture_timing: after authoritative rejection and before any continuation model request

provenance.authority: production CandidateVerifier followed by P2 reference criterion

conditions.t1: C0 plus classification and code/paths/expected/actual finding
conditions.t2: T1 plus bounded abstract repair_goal without commands, patches, or answers

formal_execution.checkpoint_capture_timing: after authoritative rejection and before any continuation model request
